title_sq: Okazion!! Ne Bllok, Buze Rruges Kryesore Shitet Apartament 3+1, Mundesi Ideale Investimi !!
description_sq: Okazion!! Ne Bllok, Buze Rruges Kryesore Shitet Apartament 3+1, Mundesi Ideale Investimi !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 te nje pallati 10-katesh te mireadministruar me ashensor. Apartamenti organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni ndenjes me dalje ne ballkon, gatimi i vecuar, dy dhomat e gjumit, dhoma matrimoniale me tualet te dedikuar dhe me dalje ne veranden e mbyllur, nje tualet tjeter dhe nje depo. Apartamenti aktualisht eshte i dhene me qira 1300 euro ne muaj. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: Opportunity!! Apartment 3+1 for sale, ideal investment opportunity!!
description_en: Opportunity!! Apartment 3+1 for sale, ideal investment opportunity!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a well-managed 10-story building with an elevator. The apartment is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with access to the balcony, a separate kitchen, two bedrooms, a matrimonial room with a dedicated toilet and access to the closed veranda, another toilet and a storage room. The apartment is currently rented for 1300 euros per month. The property has full mortgage documentation.
